items.exampleEn: The camp had no sanitary facilities, so we used the toilets at a gas station.
items.exampleZh: 營地沒有衛生設施，所以我們去加油站上廁所。

items.exampleEn: Drops of perspiration ran down the runner's face at the finish line.
items.exampleZh: 終點線上，跑者臉上的汗珠不斷流下。

items.exampleEn: A pandemic is a disease that spreads across many countries at the same time.
items.exampleZh: 全球大流行是指同時在許多國家擴散的疾病。

items.exampleEn: The sick horse was kept in quarantine, away from the other animals.
items.exampleZh: 那匹生病的馬被隔離起來，遠離其他動物。

items.exampleEn: The runner was banned from the race for using a stimulant.
items.exampleZh: 那名跑者因為使用興奮劑而被禁止參賽。

items.exampleEn: Astronauts get their nourishment from specially packed food.
items.exampleZh: 太空人從特別包裝的食物中獲得養分。

items.exampleEn: The retina is a thin layer at the back of the eye.
items.exampleZh: 視網膜是眼球後方的一層薄膜。

items.exampleEn: After an exhausting week, she slept for twelve hours.
items.exampleZh: 累人的一週過後，她睡了十二個小時。

items.sentenceEn: Light enters the eye and forms an image on the retina.
items.sentenceZh: 光線進入眼睛，在視網膜上形成影像。

items.audioEn: That twelve-hour flight was exhausting. I'm going straight to bed.
items.audioZh: 那趟十二小時的飛行累死我了，我要直接去睡覺。
items.questionZh: 說話者接下來要做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Many people learned to work from home during the pandemic.
items.sentenceZh: 疫情期間，很多人學會了在家工作。

items.sentenceEn: In the past, ships had to wait in quarantine for forty days before entering the port.
items.sentenceZh: 從前，船隻必須先隔離四十天，才能進港。

items.stemEn: Climbing a mountain in the hot sun is truly ____.
items.stemZh: 在大太陽下爬山真的很累人。

items.stemEn: Young birds depend on their parents for ____ until they can find food themselves.
items.stemZh: 幼鳥在能自己覓食之前，都要依靠父母提供養分。

items.passageEn: My cousin works at a public health office, and she told me about her job. During the pandemic, her team checked that hospitals had sanitary conditions and helped people in quarantine get food and supplies. The work was exhausting, and she often came home covered in perspiration after long days in protective clothing. Now her team studies other topics, such as how stimulants in coffee and energy drinks affect sleep and how children get enough nourishment at school. She also mentioned a new eye test that takes a picture of the retina. She says the job is hard, but she loves feeling useful. After a long day at work, her favorite treat is a big mango.
items.passageZh: 我的表親在公共衛生單位工作，她跟我聊了她的工作。疫情期間，她的團隊檢查醫院的衛生狀況是否合格，並協助被隔離的人取得食物和物資。工作非常累人，在防護衣裡熬過漫長的一天後，她回家時常常滿身是汗。現在她的團隊研究其他主題，例如咖啡和能量飲料裡的刺激物如何影響睡眠，以及孩子在學校能否獲得足夠的營養。她也提到一種新的眼睛檢查，會拍下視網膜的照片。她說這份工作很辛苦，但她喜歡覺得自己有用。忙了一整天下班後，她最愛的點心是一顆大芒果。

questions.questionZh: 疫情期間，作者表親的團隊做了什麼？
options: 到國外協助興建好幾間新醫院
檢查醫院衛生、幫助隔離者
替各大醫院招募新的護理人員
替各大學舉辦免費的健康講座

questions.questionZh: 作者的表親下班後最愛的點心是什麼？

items.promptZh: 茶葉裡含有一種天然的刺激物。
referenceEn: Tea leaves contain a natural stimulant.
There is a natural stimulant in tea leaves.
rubricZh: stimulant 是可數名詞（例如 a natural stimulant）
「含有」可寫 contain、there is… in 等

items.promptZh: 疫情期間，很多婚禮都延期了。
referenceEn: Many weddings were put off during the pandemic.
During the pandemic, lots of weddings were postponed.
rubricZh: pandemic 指「（疾病的）全球大流行」（例如 during the pandemic 等）
「延期」可寫，例如 were put off、were postponed、were delayed 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 were postponed、have been postponed 等）；時間詞位置不扣分
